interpretation.plain_speak: The fifth vocabulary is learnable. When Wingless trains only on it, fifth-family accuracy rises much higher, but older vocabularies are damaged. Balanced five-family training protects old knowledge by giving up some fifth-family performance. The problem is how to share learning capacity without forgetting, not whether the fifth family can be learned at all.
interpretation.north_star_question: Identifies the limiting mechanism for scaling sequential language capability: balancing new lexical plasticity against retention of prior families under fixed recurrent state and memory.
interpretation.next_stage: map a preregistered fixed-total-update-mass allocation curve between prior-family retention and fifth-family learning without adding budget or capacity
